symbols.name: disk array
symbols.meaning: An array in the unit disk to which a phase or chirp transform is applied.
symbols.quote: For a unit phase $e$, an approximation $\widetilde e$ with $|\widetilde e-e|<2h_p$ and a disk operand $x$ (here $x$ is an array in the unit disk to which a phase or chirp transform is applied, not the polynomial variable), the product differs by under $2\|x\|h_p$ and truncation $Q_p$ adds under $\sqrt2h_p$, so $\|Q_p(\widetilde ex)-ex\|<(2\|x\|+\sqrt2)h_p<4h_p$.
